# FounderPostAI

> FounderPostAI publishes AI Suite, a WordPress AI SEO system for reviewable search titles, meta descriptions, safe internal links, and optional bulk automation.

Use the AI Suite product reference as the canonical source for current versions, requirements, features, pricing, privacy details, and direct downloads.

## Product documentation

- [AI Suite product facts and technical overview](https://founderpostai.com/ai-suite): Canonical, human-readable reference for the complete product line.
- [FounderPostAI homepage](https://founderpostai.com/): Product storefront, free downloads, plan comparison, and checkout links.
- [FounderPostAI WordPress.org profile](https://profiles.wordpress.org/founderpostai/): Official WordPress.org publisher profile.

## Policies and support

- [Privacy policy](https://founderpostai.com/privacy): Data collection, AI processing, provider keys, subprocessors, and user rights.
- [Terms of service](https://founderpostai.com/terms): Subscriptions, refunds, licenses, AI processing, and liability.
- [Support](mailto:support@founderpostai.com): Product and account questions.
